segments.t: Configure korTTY's own application log: where it is stored and how long old log files are kept. Open via KTPH001Configuration → Global Settings → LoggingKTPH002; stored in KTPH000.

This tab is about KTPH000, the file korTTY writes about itself (startup, connections, errors) for support and troubleshooting. It does not record what your terminal sessions print. Terminal output is logged per connection, in KTPH001Connection Manager → Terminal LoggingKTPH002 or with the KTPH003Terminal logKTPH004 option of Quick Connect; see KTPH005Terminal loggingKTPH006. The tab says so at the top and links to that section with KTPH007Open in manualKTPH008.

KTPH001Log retentionKTPH002: Set to KTPH000 for unlimited retention; otherwise, log archives older than the specified number of days are deleted automatically. Archives older than 24 hours are compressed automatically.

The same tab also holds the global KTPH000session journalKTPH001 settings: the journal storage folder, whether AI summaries are generated by default, the default summary interval and the AI profile used for summaries. They are documented on the KTPH002session journalKTPH003 page.
